description: See why each of your open pull requests is not merged yet: failing CI, unresolved review comments, requested changes or conflicts. Your open, merged and closed pull requests sit in one My PRs tab, grouped by repository. Open a pull request to see each failing job by pipeline with its error messages and a link to its logs. Its review threads show who asked, every reply, and which ones wait on your reply. Uses the GitHub CLI login on the machine running bb, or a personal access token you add in the plugin settings; github.com only.
